mapper.sql: id, finding_no, finding_type, title, description, control_id, risk_id, severity, dept, owner, risk_impact, root_cause, recommendation, discovery_date, due_date, completion_date, status, remediation_progress, remediation_plan, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itgc_finding ( finding_no, finding_type, title, description, control_id, risk_id, severity, dept, owner, risk_impact, root_cause, recommendation, discovery_date, due_date, status, remediation_plan, remediation_progress, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{findingNo}, #{findingType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{controlId}, #{riskId}, #{severity}, #{dept}, #{owner}, #{riskImpact}, #{rootCause}, #{recommendation}, #{discoveryDate}, #{dueDate}, #{status}, #{remediationPlan}, #{remediationProgress}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE itgc_finding SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, severity = #{severity}, owner = #{owner}, due_date = #{dueDate}, status = #{status}, remediation_plan = #{remediationPlan}, remediation_progress = #{remediationProgress}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM itgc_finding WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM itgc_finding WHERE status IN ('미결','조치중') AND due_date < #{today}
SELECT FROM itgc_finding WHERE status IN ('미결','조치중') AND due_date < #{today} ORDER BY due_date

SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '미결' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '조치중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '조치완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM itgc_finding GROUP BY severity ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN '심각' THEN 1 WHEN '높음' THEN 2 WHEN '중간' THEN 3 WHEN '낮음' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
